request.description: Inbound messages are automatically threaded in conversations if the channels and senders are configured for using Conversations. To send an outbound message use this method with the following parameters, adding it to an existing conversation. Please note that the response from sending a TEMPLATE content type is a message of the TEXT content type, containing the template content filled with parameters. Also, HTTP header should contain parameter "x-agent-id" as agent identifier, but only in case conversations are assigned to agents. More info

The first rule matching the message will be used. More info
